reviewer.independence_basis: Separate agent from coordinating implementation run /root. Personally read the exact original PDF and authored an independent source-principal and raw-capture audit. Did not author the model, reference study, shared solver or compiled captures. Inherited task context; no compiled or vendor execution.

scope: Exact unchanged Nakai–Hinokio 2004 one-a clay with Appendix V and project endpoint backward Euler; compression-positive Mandel, fixed-frame infinitesimal effective Cauchy stress. Isolated current native and Wasm support is limited to exact Table 2 NC inputs: p=98 kPa, rho=0, e=.83, isotropic auxiliary diagonal .5773502691896257, all eight Table 2 defaults; 100 monotonic steps, zero cycles, settings 2e-10,1e-6,45,14,20000,11. Oedometric, drained, zero-volume undrained, and isotropic examples at 1% axial/normal target, and zero-volume signed deviator stress control at 5 kPa. The same drained-only example also qualifies using the exact definition auxiliary diagonal .5773502691896258 on native and scope-aware Wasm with the captured exact linear controls. Only these short illustrative lab inputs are approved; saved material trajectories are supporting diagnostics.
limitations: Table 2 gives the constants and NC reference intercept; these project examples do not reproduce the source specimen preparation or validate against observations. Parameter metadata bounds and arbitrary initialized states are not qualified.

Sustained softening, meaningful peak/branch crossing, general cyclic/reversal response and general constitutive tangent are outside scope. Endpoint BE has finite reference-intercept drift and a numerical hydrostatic Newton derivative.

Pore pressure is host-reconstructed change only when the zero-volume control assumptions apply. No coupled pressure evolution, physical-time response, finite deformation/spin, anisotropy, structured soil, sand, or FE host claim.
Standard Atlas integration, packaged browser qualification and live delivery remain separate. No deployment authorization is conveyed by the record.
Source commit identifies review checkout base; current isolated artifacts and uncommitted working receipts are bound by SHA-256, and publication must preserve exact model and evidence bytes.
